subject: Limiting analysis to a timeframe, and changing how plots are drawn

messages.author: fb3e33a97297883e
messages.subject: Limiting analysis to a timeframe, and changing how plots are drawn
parts:
My colleagues and I are trying to run GGIR with GeneActiv Actiwatch Sleep data. We're all rather inexperienced with R (more used to Python, SPSS etc) but we're feeding GGIR the bin files, and we're getting some nice output. 

The two main flies in the ointment at present are:

  1. We can't figure out how to get the graphs in the 'file summary reports' folder to go from noon to noon. In the PLOS ONE paper, the graphs seem to do just that, which is ideas for sleep analysis. But we're getting midnight to midnight. We're new to this package and it's not obvious what argument to pass to GGIR to get it to behave this way. 
  2. We've tried using maxdur=7, or using start and end arguments with timestamps, but we still get output for the whole bin file. In a nutshell, our bin files fun from 2pm on a Monday for 14 days. We'd like output for week one, until 2pm on the second Monday, then a separate output for the second week, leading up to the third Monday. We realise we'll need to run the package twice, but at present we get an analysis of the whole data file regardless of the options we're playing with. 

Here's what we're attempting (R v2.3.2 on OS X 10.11.3)...

g.shell.GGIR(mode=c(1,2,3,4),datadir=c("/Users/LHW/Analysis/sleeptestinput"),outputdir=c("/Users/LHW/Analysis/sleeptestoutput"),studyname=c(sleepstudy),f0=1,f1=2,do.report=c(2),overwrite=FALSE,visualreport=TRUE, M5L5res=5, use.temp=TRUE, printsummary=TRUE, print.filename=TRUE, maxdur=7)

 

Sorry if these are newbie questions. Any help anyone can offer will be hugely appreciated. 

Lee

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Limiting analysis to a timeframe, and changing how plots are drawn
parts:
1. Did you try using argument viewingwindow = 2?
2. You can look at the day by day summaries and split them by week yourself. Reports per week in a multi-week measurement are currently not supported by the package.
Vincent
